definition_zh: 跨文化互动的；不同文化之间的；涉及文化间交流与理解的
definition_en: relating to interaction, exchange or communication between different cultures
core_image: 一张圆桌两侧坐着两所学校的学生，各自用对方的语言介绍自己家乡的节日
scene: 两所学校的师生围坐在一张长桌旁，用对方的语言介绍自家的节日，The exchange programme builds intercultural competence through shared projects.
sceneCN: 这里 intercultural 指「涉及不同文化之间互动与理解的」（第 4 个义项：跨文化互动能力）；句意为这个交流项目通过共同课题培养跨文化能力。图中可辨识物件：长桌、两种文字的笔记、节日照片、互递的茶杯。

pos.zh: 跨文化的；不同文化之间的；涉及文化间交流的

derivatives.zh: 跨文化主义（强调文化间互动）

senses.title: Between different cultures
senses.definition: existing or happening between two or more cultures
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生于两种以上文化之间的
senses.example: The museum opened an intercultural dialogue between its Greek and Chinese collections.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆让它的希腊藏品与中国藏品展开了一场跨文化对话。
senses.why: The prefix means between, so the adjective starts by placing something in the space that separates cultures rather than inside one of them.
senses.whyCN: 前缀意为「在……之间」，因此这个形容词首先把事物放在文化之间的空间里，而不是放在某一种文化内部。

senses.title: Of communication across cultures
senses.definition: relating to communication in which the participants come from different cultural backgrounds
senses.definitionCN: 与参与者来自不同文化背景的交际有关的
senses.example: Intercultural communication fails when both sides read silence in opposite ways.
senses.exampleCN: 当双方对沉默的理解相反时，跨文化交际就会失败。
senses.why: Communication is the first place where the between shows: the same gesture carries different meanings on each side of the table.
senses.whyCN: 交际是「之间」最先显现的地方：同一个手势在桌子两边含义不同。

senses.title: Of exchange between groups
senses.definition: relating to the exchange of people, ideas or practices between cultural groups
senses.definitionCN: 与文化群体之间人员、观念或实践交流有关的
senses.example: The twin towns run an intercultural exchange of cooks and gardeners.
senses.exampleCN: 这两座姊妹城市开展厨师与园丁的跨文化交换。
senses.why: Exchange makes the relation two-way: each side sends something and receives something, so the adjective implies motion in both directions.
senses.whyCN: 交流让关系变成双向：每一边都送出一些、也接收一些，因此这个形容词暗含两个方向的移动。

senses.title: Of competence in crossing cultures
senses.definition: relating to the skills needed to interact effectively and respectfully across cultures
senses.definitionCN: 与有效且得体地跨文化互动所需的技能有关的
senses.example: The exchange programme builds intercultural competence through shared projects.
senses.exampleCN: 这个交流项目通过共同课题培养跨文化能力。
senses.why: Once interaction becomes a skill to be taught, the adjective qualifies training, competence and sensitivity rather than mere contact.
senses.whyCN: 一旦互动变成可教的技能，这个形容词就修饰训练、能力与敏感度，而不只是「接触」。

senses.title: Of education that connects cultures
senses.definition: relating to teaching that deliberately puts students from different cultures into relation
senses.definitionCN: 与有意让不同文化的学生建立关系的教学有关的
senses.example: Intercultural education asks students to compare their own customs with another's.
senses.exampleCN: 跨文化教育要求学生把自己的习俗与他人的习俗作比较。
senses.why: Schools can arrange the meeting that society leaves to chance, so the adjective attaches to curricula and classrooms.
senses.whyCN: 学校可以把社会交给偶然的相遇安排出来，因此这个形容词附着于课程与课堂。

senses.title: Of management across cultures
senses.definition: relating to organizing work or business across different cultural settings
senses.definitionCN: 与在不同文化环境中组织工作或商务有关的
senses.example: Intercultural management decides whether a deadline is rude or merely firm.
senses.exampleCN: 跨文化管理要判断一个截止期限是失礼，还是只是坚定。
senses.why: When firms employ people from several cultures, the between becomes a practical problem of rules, hierarchy and time.
senses.whyCN: 当企业雇用来自多种文化的人，「之间」就变成规则、等级与时间上的实际问题。

senses.title: Of translation and mediation
senses.titleCN: 翻译与调解中的跨文化
senses.definition: relating to the work of carrying meaning across cultural as well as linguistic boundaries
senses.definitionCN: 与把意义跨越语言及文化边界传递的工作有关的
senses.example: Intercultural translation changes the example, not only the words.
senses.exampleCN: 跨文化翻译改的是例子，而不只是词句。
senses.why: Translation shows that language and culture cannot be separated: a faithful rendering may still need a different custom to be understood.
senses.whyCN: 翻译表明语言与文化无法分开：忠实的译文有时仍要换一个习俗才被理解。

senses.title: Of relationships between members of different cultures
senses.titleCN: 不同文化成员之间的关系
senses.definition: describing a marriage, friendship or partnership between people raised in different cultures
senses.definitionCN: 形容在不同文化中长大的人之间的婚姻、友谊或伴侣关系
senses.example: Their intercultural marriage keeps two calendars on the kitchen wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的跨文化婚姻在厨房墙上挂着两本日历。
senses.why: The same between can shrink to a single household, where two cultural habits must share one room.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「之间」可以缩小到一个家庭，两种文化习惯必须共享一间屋子。

intro.en: Intercultural joins Latin inter, between, with cultural, from Latin cultura, tilling and care. The word is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: intercultural 由拉丁语 inter「在……之间」与 cultural 结合而成，后者来自拉丁语 cultura「耕作、照料」。这是现代词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Inter meant between or among. It is one of the most productive Latin prefixes in English, building international, interact and intervene.
items.cn: inter 意为「在……之间、在……之中」。它是英语中最能产的拉丁前缀之一，构成 international（国际的）、interact（互动）与 intervene（介入）。

items.en: Cultura, tilling and care, came from colere, to till or worship; English culture and cultural descend from it.
items.cn: cultura 意为耕作与照料，来自 colere「耕种、敬拜」；英语 culture 与 cultural 都由此而来。

items.en: The adjective ending -alis, of or belonging to, built culturalis in later Latin and shaped English cultural.
items.cn: 形容词词尾 -alis 意为「属于……的」，在较晚的拉丁语中构成 culturalis，并塑造了英语 cultural。

items.en: Intercultural appeared as travel, trade and migration made regular contact between cultures a subject of study.
items.cn: 随着旅行、贸易与移民使文化间的经常接触成为研究对象，intercultural 一词出现。

items.en: The phrase intercultural communication spread after the mid twentieth century, and intercultural competence later became standard in education and management.
items.cn: 跨文化交际这一说法在二十世纪中叶以后扩散，跨文化能力后来成为教育与管理领域的标准用语。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first English use of intercultural is not securely dated, and the pre-Latin origin of colere remains unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：intercultural 在英语中的最早使用没有确切年代；colere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: The first group holds words built on the same cultural stem; the second holds adjectives for relations that cross other kinds of boundary.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在同一 cultural 词干上的词；第二组是跨越其他类型边界的形容词。

entries.definition: Happening within one culture; the prefix intra- means inside, while inter- means between.
entries.definitionCN: 发生在一种文化内部；前缀 intra- 意为「在内」，而 inter- 意为「之间」。

entries.definition: Containing several cultures in one place; it describes a mixture, while intercultural describes the relation between cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 在一个地点包含多种文化；它描述混合，而 intercultural 描述文化之间的关系。

entries.definition: Comparing one culture with another, often in research; intercultural stresses the interaction itself rather than the comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 常在研究中对一种文化与另一种文化作比较；intercultural 强调互动本身，而非比较。

entries.tag: one culture or culture in general
entries.definition: Relating to culture without saying between whom; it lacks the between-prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 与文化有关，但不说在谁与谁之间；它没有表示「之间」的前缀。

entries.definition: Extending across or beyond cultures, often used of ideas that lose their local origin; intercultural keeps both sides distinct.
entries.definitionCN: 跨越或超越文化，常用于失去地方来源的观念；intercultural 则保留双方的区别。

entries.definition: Between nations as political units; it concerns borders and governments, while intercultural concerns shared meanings.
entries.definitionCN: 作为政治单位的国家之间；它涉及边界与政府，而 intercultural 涉及共有意义。

entries.definition: Open to people and influences from many countries; it describes an attitude, not a structured interaction.
entries.definitionCN: 对来自许多国家的人与影响持开放态度；它描述一种态度，而非有结构的互动。

entries.definition: Involving two parties, usually states; it counts the parties, while intercultural names the kind of difference between them.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及两方，通常指国家；它数的是当事方，而 intercultural 指明双方差异的性质。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real between-prefix, the real culture stem and the phrases the word actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：表示「之间」的真实前缀、真实的 culture 词干，以及这个词实际常用的搭配。

normal.en: inter- means between, as in international and interact; cultural means of culture, so the word says between cultures.
normal.cn: inter- 表示「在……之间」，如 international（国际的）与 interact（互动）；cultural 表示「文化的」，所以这个词说的是「文化之间」。

normal.en: The family runs intercultural, interculturalism, interculturality and interculturally.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 intercultural（跨文化的）、interculturalism（跨文化主义）、interculturality（跨文化性）、interculturally（跨文化地）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: intercultural communication, intercultural dialogue, intercultural competence, intercultural exchange.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：跨文化交际、跨文化对话、跨文化能力、跨文化交流。

normal.en: Contrast the prefixes: inter- is between, intra- is inside, multi- is many inside, cross- is across.
normal.cn: 对照前缀：inter- 指之间，intra- 指内部，multi- 指内部有多个，cross- 指横跨。

normal.en: The word became common when regular contact between cultures needed a name.
normal.cn: 当文化间的经常接触需要一个名字时，这个词才流行起来。

abstract.en: Picture two people passing a cup across a table, each holding one handle.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人隔着桌子递一只杯子，各握一个把手。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge whose two ends are built in different styles but must carry the same load.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥，两端建筑风格不同，却必须承受同样的重量。

abstract.en: Picture a conversation in which each speaker hears the other's silence differently.
abstract.cn: 想象一场对话，双方对彼此的沉默听出了不同意思。

examples.en: Intercultural dialogue begins when each side explains its own assumptions.
examples.cn: 跨文化对话从双方各自说明自己的预设开始。

examples.en: The firm hired an intercultural trainer before opening the overseas office.
examples.cn: 公司在开设海外办事处之前聘请了一位跨文化培训师。

examples.en: Their intercultural friendship survives because neither treats the other's habits as wrong.
examples.cn: 他们的跨文化友谊得以维持，因为双方都不把对方的习惯当作错的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特」加「文化的」——互联网把不同文化连在中间，跨文化就是文化之间的事。

root: 由拉丁语 inter「在……之间」与 cultural 结合而成；cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura「耕作、照料」，再往前是 colere「耕种、敬拜」。colere 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one between: the gap itself, then talk across it, exchange, skill, schooling, management, translation and finally a single household.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个「之间」展开：先是间隙本身，再是跨过它的谈话、交换、技能、学校教育、管理、翻译，最后缩到一个家庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs facing each other across a table, each with its own cup.
core.cn: 核心意象：两把椅子隔着桌子相对，各有一只自己的杯子。

branches.en: THE GAP: the adjective first names the space that separates cultures, before anything happens in it.
branches.cn: 间隙：这个形容词先命名分隔文化的空间，然后才谈其中发生的事。

branches.en: TALK AND SKILL: communication across the gap can succeed or fail, so it becomes a competence to be trained.
branches.cn: 谈话与技能：跨过间隙的交际会成功也会失败，于是它变成一种可训练的能力。

branches.en: EXCHANGE AND INTIMACY: exchange moves both ways, and the same relation can shrink to a marriage.
branches.cn: 交换与亲密：交流是双向的，同一种关系也可以缩小为一段婚姻。

branches.en: SCHOOLING: the classroom arranges the meeting that daily life leaves to chance.
branches.cn: 学校教育：课堂把日常生活交给偶然的相遇安排出来。

branches.en: WORK AND TRANSLATION: rules, deadlines and meaning all have to cross the same gap.
branches.cn: 工作与翻译：规则、截止期限与意义都得跨过同一道间隙。

intro.en: Intercultural is a between-prefix, a culture stem and an adjective ending, with further endings building the abstract nouns.
intro.cn: intercultural 是一个表示「之间」的前缀、一个 culture 词干与一个形容词词尾，后续词尾又造出抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter, between, joins cultura and its adjective ending -alis; the compound is modern, but every piece is ancient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter「在……之间」与 cultura 及其形容词词尾 -alis 结合；复合词是现代造的，但每一段都很古老。

items.example: The prefix builds international and interact.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀构成 international（国际的）与 interact（互动）。

items.example: The noun became English culture through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词经法语成为英语 culture。

items.example: The ending builds cultural and natural.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 cultural（文化的）与 natural（自然的）。

items.example: The school runs an intercultural programme.
items.exampleCN: 这所学校开展跨文化项目。

items.meaning: a doctrine stressing exchange between cultures
items.meaningCN: 强调文化间交流的学说
items.example: Interculturalism prefers dialogue to separate coexistence.
items.exampleCN: 跨文化主义更倾向对话，而不是彼此分隔的共存。

items.meaning: the quality of being between cultures
items.example: The project studies the interculturality of border towns.
items.exampleCN: 该项目研究边境城镇的跨文化性。

items.example: The team works interculturally.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队以跨文化的方式工作。

items.example: The study looks at intracultural variation.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究考察文化内部的差异。

items.meaningCN: 跨文化的；作文化比较的
items.example: The survey is a cross-cultural comparison.
items.exampleCN: 这项调查是一项跨文化比较。

derivatives.meaning: the doctrine of exchange between cultures
derivatives.meaningCN: 强调文化间交流的学说

derivatives.meaning: the state of being between cultures

definition_zh: 跨文化的；比较不同文化的；横跨多种文化边界的
definition_en: comparing or spanning two or more cultures
core_image: 一张长桌上并排摆着两户人家的晚餐照片，研究者用同一张表格逐项对照
scene: 一张长桌上并排摆着两户人家的晚餐照片，研究者用同一张表格逐项对照，The study offers a cross-cultural comparison of family dinners.
sceneCN: 这里 cross-cultural 指「对不同文化作比较的」（第 1 个义项：跨文化比较）；句意为这项研究对家庭晚餐作了跨文化比较。图中可辨识物件：两张晚餐照片、对照表格、铅笔、标尺。

pos.zh: 跨文化的；比较不同文化的；横跨文化边界的

derivatives.zh: 跨文化地；作跨文化比较地

senses.title: Comparing two or more cultures
senses.definition: comparing the customs, values or practices of two or more cultures
senses.definitionCN: 比较两种以上文化的习俗、价值观或实践
senses.example: The study offers a cross-cultural comparison of family dinners.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究对家庭晚餐作了跨文化比较。
senses.why: The word cross marks a line drawn from one culture to another: the point is the comparison, not life inside either culture.
senses.whyCN: cross 表示从一种文化划向另一种文化的线：重点是比较，而不是任一种文化内部的生活。

senses.title: Of communication across cultural lines
senses.definition: relating to communication between people from different cultural backgrounds
senses.definitionCN: 与不同文化背景的人之间交际有关的
senses.example: Cross-cultural communication breaks down when a joke crosses the line without its context.
senses.exampleCN: 当一个笑话越过界线却丢了语境，跨文化交际就会中断。
senses.why: Even when the emphasis is on interaction, the crossing image remains: a message travels from one side and must be decoded on the other.
senses.whyCN: 即使重点在互动，跨越的意象仍在：信息从一边出发，必须在另一边被解码。

senses.title: A research method comparing societies
senses.titleCN: 比较不同社会的研究方法
senses.definition: designating a research method that tests the same question in several cultural settings
senses.definitionCN: 指在多个文化环境中检验同一问题的研究方法
senses.example: Cross-cultural research must check that its questionnaire means the same thing everywhere.
senses.exampleCN: 跨文化研究必须检验问卷在各处是否表达同一意思。
senses.why: A method needs a name for its axis, and cross-cultural labels studies whose independent variable is culture itself.
senses.whyCN: 方法需要给比较轴一个名字，cross-cultural 就标记那些把文化本身当作自变量的研究。

senses.title: Spanning markets in business
senses.titleCN: 商业中横跨多个市场的
senses.definition: relating to marketing or management that operates in several cultural markets at once
senses.definitionCN: 与同时经营多个文化市场的营销或管理有关的
senses.example: The firm ran a cross-cultural campaign that kept one slogan but changed every image.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司做了一场跨文化营销，口号不变，图像全换。
senses.why: Commerce is where the comparison becomes money: the same product must be read correctly on both sides of the cultural line.
senses.whyCN: 商业让比较变成金钱：同一件产品必须在文化界线两边都被正确读懂。

senses.title: Education across cultural boundaries
senses.definition: relating to teaching that takes students across cultural boundaries or compares cultures in class
senses.definitionCN: 与带学生跨越文化边界、或在课堂中比较文化的教学有关的
senses.example: The cross-cultural exchange sent students to live with families abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 这次跨文化交流把学生送到国外家庭里生活。
senses.why: Education makes the crossing temporary and safe, so students can return with the comparison in hand.
senses.whyCN: 教育让跨越变成暂时的、安全的，学生可以带着比较的结果回来。

senses.title: The comparative tradition in anthropology
senses.definition: relating to the anthropological practice of setting societies side by side to explain differences
senses.definitionCN: 与把不同社会并置以解释差异的人类学实践有关的
senses.example: Early cross-cultural anthropology compared kinship terms across dozens of societies.
senses.exampleCN: 早期跨文化人类学比较了几十个社会的亲属称谓。
senses.why: Anthropology turned the crossing into a discipline: the method is to place many cases on one table and look for patterns.
senses.whyCN: 人类学把跨越变成一门学科：方法就是把许多案例摆到一张桌上寻找模式。

senses.title: Of a life lived across cultures
senses.titleCN: 横跨多种文化的生活经历
senses.definition: describing a person's upbringing or experience formed by living in more than one culture
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个人的成长或经历由在不止一种文化中生活所塑造
senses.example: Her cross-cultural childhood left her fluent in two languages and shy in both.
senses.exampleCN: 她的跨文化童年让她两种语言都流利，却在两种语言里都害羞。
senses.why: The comparison can become personal: one life moves back and forth across the line until both sides are partly home.
senses.whyCN: 比较也可以变成个人的：一条生命在界线两边来回移动，直到两边都有一部分成为家。

senses.title: Understanding that crosses cultural lines
senses.definition: relating to understanding or empathy that reaches beyond one's own cultural assumptions
senses.definitionCN: 与超出自身文化预设的理解或共情有关的
senses.example: Cross-cultural understanding begins with the admission that one's own habits are local.
senses.exampleCN: 跨文化理解从承认自己的习惯只是本地习惯开始。
senses.why: The final sense turns the crossing inward: the line is not only between societies but through one person's assumptions.
senses.whyCN: 最后一个义项把跨越转向内部：界线不仅在社会之间，也穿过一个人的预设。

intro.en: Cross-cultural joins the English word cross, which came from Latin crux through Irish and Old English, with cultural, from Latin cultura. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cross-cultural 由英语词 cross 与 cultural 结合而成；cross 经爱尔兰语与古英语来自拉丁语 crux，cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura。年代均为约数。

items.en: Crux meant a cross, a gallows or a torture stake. Its deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: crux 意为十字架、绞架或刑柱。它更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Old Irish cros borrowed the Latin word during the Christian mission, and the form travelled to Old English as cros.
items.cn: 古爱尔兰语 cros 在基督教传教时期借入这个拉丁词，这一形式又作为 cros 传入古英语。

items.en: Old English cros named the physical cross and also produced cross as a word for a crossing or a mark.
items.cn: 古英语 cros 指实体的十字架，并产生了 cross 这个词，用来指交叉或标记。

items.en: English uses cross- to mean across, crossing or opposing, as in cross-country, cross-border and cross-purpose.
items.cn: 英语用 cross- 表示「横跨、越过或相反」，如 cross-country（越野的）、cross-border（跨境的）、cross-purpose（目的相左）。

items.en: Cross-cultural was formed in the twentieth century when comparative research needed a compact adjective for studies spanning cultures.
items.cn: cross-cultural 在二十世纪形成，当时比较研究需要一个紧凑的形容词来指跨越文化的研究。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first English use of cross-cultural is not securely dated, and the pre-Latin origin of crux is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：cross-cultural 在英语中的最早使用没有确切年代；crux 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: The first group holds near spellings and the related cultural adjectives; the second holds words that also cross a boundary of some kind.
note.cn: 第一组是相近拼写与相关的 cultural 形容词；第二组是同样跨越某种边界的词。

entries.definition: A spelling without the hyphen; the standard written form keeps cross-cultural, and the unhyphenated form is best avoided in careful prose.
entries.definitionCN: 不带连字符的拼法；规范书面形式保留 cross-cultural，严谨写作中最好避免无连字符形式。

entries.definition: Relating to culture without saying that two cultures are being compared; it lacks the crossing.
entries.definitionCN: 与文化有关，但不说在比较两种文化；它没有「跨越」之意。

entries.definition: Relating to interaction between cultures; cross-cultural stresses comparison or spanning, intercultural stresses the interaction itself.
entries.definitionCN: 与文化之间的互动有关；cross-cultural 强调比较或横跨，intercultural 强调互动本身。

entries.definition: Containing several cultures in one place; it describes a mixture rather than a comparison across a line.
entries.definitionCN: 在一个地点包含多种文化；它描述混合，而非跨线比较。

entries.definition: Relating to comparison of any kind; cross-cultural narrows the comparison to cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 与任何比较有关；cross-cultural 把比较的范围收窄到文化。

entries.definition: Extending across or beyond cultures; it suggests ideas that leave local origins behind, while cross-cultural keeps both sides in view.
entries.definitionCN: 跨越或超越文化；它暗示观念脱离地方来源，而 cross-cultural 让两边都留在视野里。

entries.definition: Between nations as political units; it concerns borders and governments rather than cultural comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 作为政治单位的国家之间；它涉及边界与政府，而非文化比较。

entries.definition: Involving several countries, usually firms or organizations; it counts states, not cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及多个国家，通常指公司或组织；它数的是国家，而不是文化。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real crossing word, the real culture stem and the phrases the word actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：表示「跨越」的真实词、真实的 culture 词干，以及这个词实际常用的搭配。

normal.en: cross means across or intersecting, as in cross-border and cross-country; cultural means of culture, so the word means across cultures.
normal.cn: cross 表示「横跨、交叉」，如 cross-border（跨境的）与 cross-country（越野的）；cultural 表示「文化的」，所以这个词的意思是「横跨文化」。

normal.en: The family runs cross-cultural, cross-culturally, cross-culturalism, intercultural and multicultural.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 cross-cultural（跨文化的）、cross-culturally（跨文化地）、cross-culturalism（跨文化主义）、intercultural（文化间互动的）、multicultural（多元文化的）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: cross-cultural comparison, cross-cultural communication, cross-cultural research.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：跨文化比较、跨文化交际、跨文化研究。

normal.en: The hyphen matters: cross-cultural is a compound adjective, not two separate words.
normal.cn: 连字符很重要：cross-cultural 是一个复合形容词，不是两个独立的词。

normal.en: The word keeps both cultures in view; it never means simply foreign.
normal.cn: 这个词让两种文化都留在视野里；它从不只是「外国的」的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a line drawn between two dinner tables and a ruler laid across it.
abstract.cn: 想象两张餐桌之间画着一条线，一把尺子横放在线上。

abstract.en: Picture one questionnaire filled in twice, once in each language.
abstract.cn: 想象同一份问卷被填了两次，每种语言各一次。

abstract.en: Picture a person standing with one foot on each side of the line.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在线上，一只脚在一边。

examples.en: The cross-cultural survey found that silence means agreement in one village and doubt in the next.
examples.cn: 这项跨文化调查发现，沉默在一个村子里表示同意，在邻村却表示怀疑。

examples.en: Cross-cultural teams often argue about deadlines before they argue about ideas.
examples.cn: 跨文化团队常常先为截止期限争论，然后才为想法争论。

examples.en: The novel is a cross-cultural portrait of two families who share a street but not a language.
examples.cn: 这部小说是两户人家的跨文化写照：他们共享一条街，却不共享一种语言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「cross（交叉）」加「文化的」——一条线从一种文化横穿到另一种文化，就是跨文化的。

root: 由英语词 cross 与 cultural 复合而成。cross 经古爱尔兰语 cros 来自拉丁语 crux「十字架、刑柱」，crux 的更早来源不确定；cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura「耕作、照料」，再往前是 colere「耕种、敬拜」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line drawn across cultures: comparison, communication, method, market, classroom, anthropology, a personal life and finally understanding.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一条横跨文化的线展开：比较、交际、方法、市场、课堂、人类学、个人生活，最后是理解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ruler laid across two cultures, measuring what differs and what matches.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把横放在两种文化上的尺子，量出哪里不同、哪里相同。

branches.en: COMPARISON: from a plain contrast of dinners to the disciplined comparison of many societies.
branches.cn: 比较：从两顿晚餐的平实对照，到对许多社会的有章法比较。

branches.en: COMMUNICATION: a message crosses the line and must be decoded on the other side.
branches.cn: 交际：信息越过界线，必须在另一边被解码。

branches.en: METHOD: culture becomes the variable that a study deliberately tests.
branches.cn: 方法：文化成为研究有意检验的变量。

branches.en: MARKET AND CLASSROOM: the same product or lesson must work on both sides of the line.
branches.cn: 市场与课堂：同一件产品或同一堂课必须在界线两边都行得通。

branches.en: PERSONAL CROSSING: a life can move back and forth until the line runs through one person's assumptions.
branches.cn: 个人的跨越：一条生命可以来回移动，直到界线穿过一个人的预设。

intro.en: Cross-cultural is an English crossing word plus a Latin-derived culture adjective, and the crossing part is itself a very old borrowing.
intro.cn: cross-cultural 由一个英语的「跨越」词加一个源自拉丁语的 culture 形容词构成，而表示跨越的部分本身是很古老的借词。

latinIntro.en: Latin crux reached English through Irish and Old English as cross; Latin cultura plus -alis gave cultural, so the compound joins two different borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crux 经爱尔兰语与古英语进入英语，成为 cross；拉丁语 cultura 加 -alis 给出 cultural，因此这个复合词把两个不同来源的借词接在一起。

items.structure: crux, crucis (f., third declension, Latin noun)
items.example: The Latin word reached English through Irish and Old English.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词经爱尔兰语与古英语进入英语。

items.example: The prefix builds cross-border and cross-country.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀构成 cross-border（跨境的）与 cross-country（越野的）。

items.example: The noun became English culture through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词经法语成为英语 culture。

items.example: The ending builds cultural and natural.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 cultural（文化的）与 natural（自然的）。

items.meaningCN: 跨文化的；作文化比较的
items.example: The study is cross-cultural.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究是跨文化的。

items.example: The team compared the data cross-culturally.
items.exampleCN: 团队对数据作了跨文化比较。

items.meaning: an approach stressing comparison across cultures
items.meaningCN: 强调跨文化比较的取向
items.example: Cross-culturalism shaped the department's method.
items.exampleCN: 跨文化主义塑造了该系的方法。

items.example: Intercultural dialogue differs from comparison.
items.exampleCN: 跨文化对话不同于比较。

items.example: The city is multicultural.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市是多元文化的。

derivatives.meaning: an approach based on comparison across cultures
derivatives.meaningCN: 以跨文化比较为基础的取向

definition_zh: 文化多样性；多种文化并存的状态；不同文化表达方式的丰富差异；（政策、教育中的）文化多元原则
definition_en: the existence of many different cultures and cultural expressions in one place or in the world
core_image: 一张社区地图上标满了不同语言的住户，每一种颜色都代表一种在家中使用的话
scene: 社区调查员挨家挨户问在家里说哪种语言，再把结果一格一格填进表格，The report measures cultural diversity by counting languages spoken at home.
sceneCN: 这里 cultural diversity 指「可以用数量衡量的文化差异程度」（第 4 个义项：可测量的文化多样性）；句意为报告通过统计家庭中使用的语言来衡量文化多样性。图中可辨识物件：社区地图、语言标签、统计表格、调查员的笔。

pos.zh: 文化多样性；多种文化并存；文化表达的丰富差异

forms.label: 复数（多种文化多样性情形）

senses.title: Many cultures existing in one society
senses.titleCN: 同一社会中存在多种文化
senses.definition: the presence of several distinct cultures within one society or place
senses.definitionCN: 同一社会或地点内存在多种不同文化
senses.example: Cultural diversity is visible in the market, where five languages share one counter.
senses.exampleCN: 文化多样性在市场上就能看见：五种语言共用同一个柜台。
senses.why: The phrase joins a cultural adjective to a noun of difference: what varies is not goods or genes but ways of life.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把「文化的」形容词与表示差异的名词连在一起：变化的不是货物或基因，而是生活方式。

senses.title: The variety of cultural expressions worldwide
senses.titleCN: 全世界文化表达的丰富差异
senses.definition: the range of languages, arts, rituals and customs found across the world
senses.definitionCN: 世界各地语言、艺术、仪式与习俗的丰富范围
senses.example: The atlas records cultural diversity in songs, scripts and seasonal feasts.
senses.exampleCN: 这本图集记录歌曲、文字与节令宴飨中的文化多样性。
senses.why: The phrase can widen from one society to the whole planet, where diversity means the total stock of human variety.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可以从一个社会扩展到整个星球，此时多样性指人类全部变异的库存。

senses.title: A policy principle and public value
senses.definition: the principle that cultural variety should be protected and supported by public policy
senses.definitionCN: 文化差异应受公共政策保护与支持的 principle
senses.example: The convention treats cultural diversity as a common heritage of humanity.
senses.exampleCN: 该公约把文化多样性视为人类的共同遗产。
senses.why: Once diversity is declared a good, the phrase moves from description to obligation: variety must be defended, not merely observed.
senses.whyCN: 一旦多样性被宣布为善，这个短语就从描述转为义务：差异必须被捍卫，而不只是被观察。

senses.title: A measurable variety
senses.definition: a quantity that can be counted or indexed, such as the number of languages or cultural groups in a place
senses.definitionCN: 可以用计数或指数衡量的量，如某地语言或文化群体的数量
senses.example: The report measures cultural diversity by counting languages spoken at home.
senses.exampleCN: 报告通过统计家庭中使用的语言来衡量文化多样性。
senses.why: Policy and research need numbers, so the phrase also names a variable that can be counted, compared and mapped.
senses.whyCN: 政策与研究需要数字，因此这个短语也命名一个可以计数、比较与绘图的变量。

senses.title: An educational principle
senses.definition: the principle that teaching should reflect and explain several cultural traditions
senses.definitionCN: 教学应反映并解释多种文化传统的原则
senses.example: Cultural diversity in the curriculum means more than adding one festival to the calendar.
senses.exampleCN: 课程中的文化多样性不只是往日历上加一个节日。
senses.why: Schools decide which inheritance is passed on, so the phrase becomes a demand about what students will read and celebrate.
senses.whyCN: 学校决定传递哪一份遗产，因此这个短语变成关于学生读什么、庆祝什么的主张。

senses.title: Variety inside an organization
senses.definition: the mix of cultural backgrounds among employees, members or students in one institution
senses.definitionCN: 一个机构内员工、成员或学生文化背景的混合
senses.example: The hospital's cultural diversity shows in its interpreters and its kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 这家医院的文化多样性体现在口译员与厨房里。
senses.why: Institutions count diversity for practical reasons: different backgrounds bring different needs, skills and blind spots.
senses.whyCN: 机构出于实际理由统计多样性：不同背景带来不同需求、技能与盲点。

senses.title: A field of study
senses.definition: the academic study of how cultural variety is produced, maintained and governed
senses.definitionCN: 研究文化差异如何产生、维持与治理的学术领域
senses.example: Cultural diversity is now a subject with its own journals and methods.
senses.exampleCN: 文化多样性如今是一个有自己的期刊与方法的研究领域。
senses.why: The phrase can name a discipline, not its object: scholars study diversity itself, including the ways it is counted.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可以指一门学科，而不只是它的对象：学者研究多样性本身，包括它被计数的方式。

senses.title: Variety represented in art and media
senses.titleCN: 艺术与媒体中呈现的多样性
senses.definition: the representation of several cultures in films, exhibitions, broadcasts or literature
senses.definitionCN: 在电影、展览、广播或文学中呈现多种文化
senses.example: The festival's cultural diversity is real only if the smaller communities also perform.
senses.exampleCN: 只有当较小的社群也登台，这个节庆的文化多样性才是真实的。
senses.why: Representation is where diversity becomes visible: a screen or a stage can either show the many cultures or flatten them into one.
senses.whyCN: 呈现是多样性变得可见之处：屏幕或舞台既可以展示多种文化，也可以把它们压成一种。

intro.en: Cultural diversity joins cultural, from Latin cultura, with diversity, from Latin diversitas and divertere, to turn apart. The phrase is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cultural diversity 由 cultural 与 diversity 结合而成；cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura，diversity 来自拉丁语 diversitas 与 divertere「转向不同方向」。这是个现代短语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn. With the prefix dis-, apart, it gave divertere, to turn aside or turn in different directions.
items.cn: vertere 意为「转动」。加上表示「分开」的前缀 dis-，构成 divertere「转向一边、转向不同方向」。

items.en: The past participle diversus meant turned apart, hence different or varied; English diverse comes from it.
items.cn: 过去分词 diversus 意为「被转向不同方向的」，因此表示「不同的、多样的」；英语 diverse 由此而来。

items.en: Diversitas named difference and variety, and English diversity was borrowed through French.
items.cn: diversitas 指差异与多样，英语 diversity 经法语借入。

items.en: Cultura, tilling and care, gave English culture and cultural; in this phrase culture means the learned way of life.
items.cn: cultura 意为耕作与照料，给出英语 culture 与 cultural；在这个短语里，culture 指习得的生活方式。

items.en: Cultural diversity became a policy phrase in the late twentieth century, and the UNESCO convention of two thousand and five fixed it in international law.
items.cn: cultural diversity 在二十世纪后期成为政策短语，二〇〇五年的联合国教科文组织公约把它写进国际法。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first English use of the phrase is not securely dated, and the pre-Latin origin of vertere remains unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这个短语在英语中的最早使用没有确切年代；vertere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: The first group holds words from the same diversity stock or its biological parallel; the second holds terms for plural societies and variety.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 diversity 词干或与之并行的生物学术语；第二组是关于多元社会与差异的术语。

entries.definition: The variety of living species and ecosystems; it borrows the diversity noun but counts organisms, not cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 生物物种与生态系统的多样性；它借用了 diversity 这个名词，但数的是生物，不是文化。

entries.definition: Variety in general; cultural diversity specifies that the variety is in cultures rather than in genes or products.
entries.definitionCN: 一般意义上的多样性；cultural diversity 指明差异在文化上，而非基因或产品上。

entries.definition: Showing much variety; the phrase cultural diversity needs the noun, while diverse can describe anything.
entries.definitionCN: 显示出丰富差异；短语 cultural diversity 需要名词，而 diverse 可描述任何事物。

entries.definition: The process of adding more kinds or types; it names an action, while cultural diversity names a state.
entries.definitionCN: 增加更多种类或类型的过程；它指动作，而 cultural diversity 指状态。

entries.definition: The policy or ideology that supports several cultures; cultural diversity can be the fact that the doctrine responds to.
entries.definitionCN: 支持多种文化的政策或意识形态；cultural diversity 可以指这套主张所回应的事实。

entries.definition: Acceptance of many groups or viewpoints; broader than cultural diversity, which focuses on culture.
entries.definitionCN: 接受多个群体或观点；比聚焦文化的 cultural diversity 更宽。

entries.definition: The quality of being made of unlike parts; it is a neutral technical term, while cultural diversity often carries a value.
entries.definitionCN: 由不同部分构成的性质；它是中性的技术术语，而 cultural diversity 常带价值判断。

entries.definition: The presence of many kinds of a thing; it is wider and less political than cultural diversity.
entries.definitionCN: 同一种事物有许多种类；它比 cultural diversity 更宽、更少政治含义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real roots of both words and the phrases the term actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个词的真实词根，以及这个术语实际常用的搭配。

normal.en: cultural means of culture, and diversity means turned apart, so the phrase names ways of life that have turned in different directions.
normal.cn: cultural 表示「文化的」，diversity 表示「被转向不同方向的」，所以这个短语指转向不同方向的各种生活方式。

normal.en: The family runs diverse, diversity, diversify, diversification and biodiversity.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 diverse（多样的）、diversity（多样性）、diversify（使多样化）、diversification（多样化）、biodiversity（生物多样性）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: preserve cultural diversity, cultural diversity policy, cultural diversity index.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：保护文化多样性、文化多样性政策、文化多样性指数。

normal.en: The word became a policy term when international bodies began protecting cultural variety.
normal.cn: 当国际机构开始保护文化差异时，这个词成为政策术语。

normal.en: Its biological twin is biodiversity; both count variety, but one counts cultures and the other counts species.
normal.cn: 它在生物学上的对应词是 biodiversity（生物多样性）；两者都数多样性，但一个数文化，一个数物种。

abstract.en: Picture a map coloured by language rather than by border.
abstract.cn: 想象一张按语言而不是按国界上色的地图。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of instruments, each tuned to a different scale, all playable in one room.
abstract.cn: 想象一架乐器，每件都调在不同的音阶上，却都能在同一间屋里演奏。

abstract.en: Picture a recipe book where no page repeats the same spice.
abstract.cn: 想象一本菜谱，没有一页重复同一种香料。

examples.en: Cultural diversity is protected by law in some countries and ignored in others.
examples.cn: 文化多样性在一些国家受法律保护，在另一些国家则被忽视。

examples.en: The museum's programme celebrates cultural diversity without turning it into a spectacle.
examples.cn: 博物馆的项目颂扬文化多样性，却没有把它变成一场奇观。

examples.en: Measuring cultural diversity by language alone misses shared customs that cross languages.
examples.cn: 只按语言衡量文化多样性，会漏掉跨语言共有的习俗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「文化的」加「多样性」——许多种文化并存，就是文化多样性。

root: 由 cultural 与 diversity 组成。cultural 来自拉丁语 cultura「耕作、照料」，再往前是 colere「耕种、敬拜」；diversity 来自拉丁语 diversitas，而 diversitas 出自动词 divertere「转向不同方向」，由 dis-「分开」与 vertere「转动」构成。colere 与 vertere 的更早来源均不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one variety: a society, the world, a policy, a number, a classroom, a workplace, a discipline and finally a stage or screen.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种「差异」展开：一个社会、整个世界、一项政策、一个数字、一间教室、一个职场、一门学科，最后是一块舞台或屏幕。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a map in which every colour is a language and no colour covers the whole page.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张地图，每种颜色都是一种语言，没有一种颜色盖满整页。

branches.en: LOCAL AND GLOBAL: the same variety can be seen inside one market or across the whole planet.
branches.cn: 本地与全球：同一种差异既可以在一个市场里看见，也可以在整个星球上看见。

branches.en: PUBLIC VALUE: variety becomes something a society is obliged to protect.
branches.cn: 公共价值：差异变成社会有义务保护的东西。

branches.en: INDEX: the variety is turned into a number that can be compared and mapped.
branches.cn: 指数：差异被转化为可以比较与绘图的数字。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS: schools and workplaces must both reflect the variety they serve.
branches.cn: 机构：学校与职场都必须反映它们所服务的多样性。

branches.en: STUDY AND SCREEN: diversity becomes a discipline, and representation becomes the test of whether it is real.
branches.cn: 研究与屏幕：多样性成为一门学科，而呈现则成为检验它是否真实的标准。

intro.en: Cultural diversity is two Latin-derived words joined: a culture adjective and a noun of turning apart.
intro.cn: cultural diversity 是两个源自拉丁语的词组合而成：一个文化形容词与一个表示「转向不同方向」的名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin cultura and -alis give cultural; dis- plus vertere give diversus, diversitas and English diversity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cultura 与 -alis 给出 cultural；dis- 加 vertere 给出 diversus、diversitas 与英语 diversity。

items.example: The verb also builds convert and reverse.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词也构成 convert（转变）与 reverse（反转）。

items.structure: dis- (Latin prefix, apart, in different directions)
items.example: The prefix turns turning into turning apart.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「转动」变成「转向不同方向」。

items.meaningCN: 被转向不同方向的；不同的
items.example: The participle gave English diverse.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词给出英语 diverse。

items.example: The noun became English diversity through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词经法语成为英语 diversity。

items.example: The noun became English culture through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词经法语成为英语 culture。

items.example: The ending builds cultural and natural.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 cultural（文化的）与 natural（自然的）。

items.example: The forest is known for its diversity.
items.exampleCN: 这片森林以多样性著称。

items.example: The farm diversified into fruit.
items.exampleCN: 这个农场多样化经营，种起了水果。

items.example: The city has a cultural programme.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市有一项文化项目。

diversus, diversa, diversum (Latin participle and adjective)
