senses.title: The stages-of-growth model
senses.definition: the version of the theory that arranges development into successive stages from traditional society to mass consumption
senses.definitionCN: 把发展排列为从传统社会到大众消费的连续阶段的理论版本
senses.example: The stages model made modernization theory look like a ladder every nation could climb.
senses.exampleCN: 阶段模型让现代化理论看起来像一架每个国家都能爬的梯子。
senses.why: The theory begins as a staircase: each stage is a step that can be named, ordered and predicted.
senses.whyCN: 这套理论起初是一道楼梯：每个阶段都是可以命名、排序与预测的一级。

senses.title: The broad sociological paradigm
senses.definition: the wider body of sociological theory that contrasts traditional and modern social structures
senses.definitionCN: 对比传统社会结构与现代社会结构的更广的社会学理论总体
senses.example: The course applies modernization theory to postcolonial economies.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把现代化理论用于殖民后的经济体。
senses.why: Beyond one author's staircase, the paradigm offers a general pair of types: traditional and modern, and a direction between them.
senses.whyCN: 在某一作者的楼梯之外，这一范式提供一对总类型：传统与现代，以及它们之间的方向。

senses.title: A policy framework for developing states
senses.titleCN: 面向发展中国家的政策框架
senses.definition: the use of the theory to justify aid, investment and institutional reform in poorer countries
senses.definitionCN: 用该理论为较贫穷国家的援助、投资与制度改革提供理由
senses.example: Modernization theory shaped the aid packages of the nineteen sixties.
senses.exampleCN: 现代化理论塑造了二十世纪六十年代的援助方案。
senses.why: A theory that predicts stages can also prescribe: if development is a ladder, policy can pay for the next rung.
senses.whyCN: 一套预测阶段的理论也可以开药方：如果发展是梯子，政策就可以为下一级出钱。

senses.title: An academic subject
senses.definition: the theory as taught in courses, textbooks and examinations
senses.definitionCN: 作为课程、教科书与考试内容来教授的理论
senses.example: Modernization theory is now taught mainly as a historical paradigm.
senses.exampleCN: 现代化理论如今主要作为历史范式来教授。
senses.why: Once a theory enters the syllabus, it becomes a subject with a canon, a critique and an exam question.
senses.whyCN: 一旦理论进入教学大纲，它就变成一门有经典、有批评、有考题的科目。

senses.title: The target of dependency critique
senses.definition: the theory as attacked by critics who say it ignores colonial exploitation and global inequality
senses.definitionCN: 被批评者攻击的理论，批评者称其忽视殖民剥削与全球不平等
senses.example: Dependency writers treated modernization theory as a cover for Western interests.
senses.exampleCN: 依附理论作者把现代化理论视为西方利益的掩护。
senses.why: A theory can become famous through its enemies: the critique gives modernization theory a second life as a cautionary example.
senses.whyCN: 一套理论可以因敌人而出名：批评让现代化理论作为反面教材获得第二次生命。

senses.title: A model applied to postcolonial nations
senses.titleCN: 应用于后殖民国家的模型
senses.definition: the theory used to explain or guide the development of states that had recently gained independence
senses.definitionCN: 用来解释或指导刚获独立国家发展的理论
senses.example: Modernization theory expected new states to repeat the European sequence.
senses.exampleCN: 现代化理论期待新国家重复欧洲的序列。
senses.why: The model travelled with decolonization: each new state was measured against a sequence that had supposedly already happened elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 这个模型随非殖民化而行：每个新国家都被拿来对照一套据说已在别处发生过的序列。

senses.title: The version applied to institutions
senses.definition: the branch of the theory that studies the modernization of bureaucracy, law and political institutions
senses.definitionCN: 研究官僚制、法律与政治制度现代化的理论分支
senses.example: Political modernization theory measured how quickly parliaments replaced personal rule.
senses.exampleCN: 政治现代化理论衡量议会取代个人统治的速度。
senses.why: The ladder can be built inside an office: institutions, not only economies, are ranked by how modern they are.
senses.whyCN: 梯子也可以搭在办公室内部：被排等级的不只是经济，还有制度本身有多现代。

senses.title: A term in development economics and history
senses.titleCN: 发展经济学与历史学中的术语
senses.definition: the label used in economics and history for the cluster of growth-centred development ideas
senses.definitionCN: 经济学与历史学用来指以增长为中心的一簇发展观念的标签
senses.example: Historians now treat modernization theory as one episode in development thinking.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家如今把现代化理论视为发展思想中的一个片段。
senses.why: Disciplines need a name for a whole episode, so the phrase also works as a period label in the history of ideas.
senses.whyCN: 学科需要给一整个片段一个名字，因此这个短语也充当思想史中的时期标签。

intro.en: Modernization theory joins modernization, from Latin modernus and modo, with theory, from Greek theoria, viewing. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: modernization theory 由 modernization 与 theory 结合而成；modernization 来自拉丁语 modernus 与 modo，theory 来自希腊语 theoria「观看」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Theoria meant a viewing, a spectacle or contemplation. It came from theoros, a spectator, and described looking at something as a whole.
items.cn: theoria 意为观看、景观或沉思，来自 theoros「观看者」，描述把某物作为一个整体来看。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria as theoria, and Late Latin theorica produced the adjective that English theory descends from.
items.cn: 拉丁语把 theoria 借为 theoria，晚期拉丁语 theorica 又产生形容词，英语 theory 由此而来。

items.en: Modo, just now, is usually derived from modus, measure or manner; the link is a standard account rather than a recorded certainty.
items.cn: modo 意为「刚刚」，通行说法认为它来自 modus「尺度、方式」；这一联系只是标准解释，并非有记录的确证。

items.en: Modernization appeared in the nineteenth century as the name of a process, then became a technical term in development studies.
items.cn: modernization 在十九世纪作为过程名称出现，后来成为发展研究中的技术术语。

items.en: The full phrase became standard in the nineteen fifties and sixties, when growth-centred development theory dominated Western social science.
items.cn: 完整短语在二十世纪五十与六十年代成为标准用语，当时以增长为中心的发展理论主导西方社会科学。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first use of the exact phrase is not securely dated, and its adoption as a school label varied by discipline and country.
items.cn: 来源不确定：这个确切短语的最早使用没有可靠年代；它作为学派标签被采纳的时间因学科与国家而异。

note.en: The first group holds the words that make up the phrase and its close morphological relatives; the second holds rival development theories.
note.cn: 第一组是构成该短语的词及其近形词；第二组是与之竞争的发展理论。

entries.definition: The process of becoming modern; the phrase adds theory, which is the explanation of that process.
entries.definitionCN: 走向现代的过程；短语加上 theory，指对这一过程的解释。

entries.definition: The state of being modern; the theory tries to explain how societies reach it.
entries.definitionCN: 现代的状态；该理论试图解释社会如何抵达这一状态。

entries.definition: The cultural movement in the arts; it is unrelated to the development paradigm except by sharing the modern stem.
entries.definitionCN: 艺术中的文化运动；除共享 modern 词干外，与发展的理论范式无关。

entries.definition: A system of explanation; alone it can describe any field, while the full phrase fixes the field to development.
entries.definitionCN: 一套解释系统；单独使用时可用于任何领域，完整短语则把领域固定在发展研究。

entries.definition: The broader body of theories about economic and social development; modernization theory is one member of it.
entries.definitionCN: 关于经济与社会发展的更广理论总体；现代化理论是其中一员。

entries.definition: The theory that poor nations are kept poor by their position in the world economy; it arose partly as a critique of modernization theory.
entries.definitionCN: 认为穷国因在世界经济中的位置而持续贫穷的理论；它部分是对现代化理论的批评。

entries.definition: The theory that industrial societies become more alike over time; it shares the assumption of a single modern destination.
entries.definitionCN: 认为工业社会随时间变得更相似的理论；它共享「现代终点唯一」的假设。

entries.definition: The theory that treats the world economy as one system of cores and peripheries; it rejects the stage ladder of modernization theory.
entries.definitionCN: 把世界经济视为由核心与边缘构成的单一系统的理论；它拒绝现代化理论的阶段阶梯。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real viewing root of theory, the real modern stem and the phrases the term actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：theory 表示「观看」的真实词根、真实的 modern 词干，以及这个术语实际常用的搭配。

normal.en: modernization names the process, and theory names the explanation: together they say how societies are supposed to become modern.
normal.cn: modernization 命名过程，theory 命名解释：合起来说的就是社会应当如何变得现代。

normal.en: theory comes from a Greek word for viewing: a theory is a way of looking at a whole.
normal.cn: theory 来自希腊语表示「观看」的词：理论就是把整体拿来看的一种方式。

normal.en: The family runs modern, modernization, modernity, theorist and theoretical.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 modern（现代的）、modernization（现代化）、modernity（现代性）、theorist（理论家）、theoretical（理论上的）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: classic modernization theory, the modernization theory paradigm, modernization theory in sociology.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：经典现代化理论、现代化理论范式、社会学中的现代化理论。

normal.en: Its great rival is dependency theory, which denies that the ladder is open to everyone.
normal.cn: 它最大的对手是依附理论，后者否认这架梯子对所有人开放。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase drawn on a blackboard with a different country standing on each step.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上画着一道楼梯，每一级都站着一个不同的国家。

abstract.en: Picture a telescope pointed at a whole society instead of a star.
abstract.cn: 想象一台望远镜不是对准星星，而是对准整个社会。

abstract.en: Picture a tide chart that claims every harbour must rise in the same order.
abstract.cn: 想象一张潮汐表，声称每个港口都必须按同一顺序涨潮。

examples.en: Modernization theory treated tradition as an obstacle rather than a resource.
examples.cn: 现代化理论把传统当作障碍，而不是资源。

examples.en: The seminar compared modernization theory with dependency theory on the same case.
examples.cn: 研讨课用同一个案例比较现代化理论与依附理论。

examples.en: Modernization theory survives today mainly as a subject of criticism.
examples.cn: 现代化理论今天主要作为批评对象而存续。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「现代化」加「理论」——把从传统到现代的发展排成阶段来讲的一套学说，就是现代化理论。

root: 由 modernization 与 theory 组成。modernization 来自 modern，后者来自晚期拉丁语 modernus「当下的」，通行说法追溯至 modo「刚刚」，modo 又常被解释为来自 modus「尺度、方式」；theory 来自希腊语 theoria「观看、沉思」，经拉丁语 theoria 进入英语。modo 与 modus 的更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one paradigm: a staircase, a broad contrast, a policy, a course, a target of attack, a model for new states, an institutional branch and a period label.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个范式展开：一道楼梯、一组总对比、一套政策、一门课、一个被攻击的靶子、一个用于新国家的模型、一个制度分支，最后是一个时期标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a staircase drawn on a blackboard, with a country standing on each step.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑板上画着一道楼梯，每一级都站着一个国家。

branches.en: THE STAIRCASE: development is arranged into nameable steps that can be ordered and predicted.
branches.cn: 楼梯：发展被排列为可以命名、排序与预测的台阶。

branches.en: THE BROAD CONTRAST: beyond one author, the paradigm offers traditional and modern as a general pair.
branches.cn: 总对比：在某一作者之外，这一范式提供「传统」与「现代」这对总类型。

branches.en: POLICY AND DISCIPLINE: the ladder justifies aid, and economics and history give the whole episode a name.
branches.cn: 政策与学科：梯子为援助提供理由，经济学与历史学又给整个片段一个名字。

branches.en: SYLLABUS: the theory becomes a course with a canon and an exam question.
branches.cn: 课程：理论变成一门有经典、有考题的课。

branches.en: ATTACK, EXPORT AND INSTITUTIONS: critics deny the ladder, new states are placed on it, and institutions get their own version.
branches.cn: 攻击、输出与制度：批评者否认梯子，新国家被放上去，制度则有自己的版本。

intro.en: Modernization theory is a process noun plus an explanation noun, and each half brings its own suffixes.
intro.cn: modernization theory 是一个过程名词加一个解释名词，两半各自带来自己的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin modernus and modo supply modernization, while Greek theoria through Latin supplies theory; the suffixes -izein and -atio build the process noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 modernus 与 modo 提供 modernization，希腊语 theoria 经拉丁语提供 theory；-izein 与 -atio 两个词尾构成过程名词。

items.example: The Greek word came from theoros, a spectator.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊词来自 theoros「观看者」。

items.structure: theoria through Latin theoria and theorica
items.example: The word entered English through French and Latin.
items.exampleCN: 这个词经法语与拉丁语进入英语。

items.example: The adjective entered English through French.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词经法语进入英语。

items.example: The ending builds modernize and organize.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 modernize（使现代化）与 organize（组织）。

items.example: The ending builds modernization.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 modernization（现代化）。

items.example: Modernization changed the harbour.
items.exampleCN: 现代化改变了这座港口。

items.example: The course applies modernization theory.
items.exampleCN: 这门课运用现代化理论。

items.example: The theorist defended the stages model.
items.exampleCN: 这位理论家为阶段模型辩护。

items.example: The ending builds theoretical.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 theoretical（理论上的）。

latinEntries.structure: theoria, theoriae (f., first declension, from Greek theoria)

latinEntries.meaning: a spectator; an envoy sent to consult an oracle
latinEntries.meaningCN: 观看者；被派去求神谕的使者
